new_result.statement: For a physical original-coordinate cross block M with Z_k=e_k(M^T M)>0, maximum I-side k-volume-sampling marginal h, and q>=max(1,2h), a=k/(2q), every 0<gamma<a satisfies an explicit weighted Fourier bound; if q<k then sup_s E|R-s|^{-1/2} <= [4a/(a-1/2)](e/q)^(1/4) Z_k^(-1/(4k)). At k=2 and h<1, q=max(1,2h)<2 gives C_2(h) Z_2^(-1/8).
new_result.linear_small_ball: If Q=d[Z+m(W)]^2+R(W) with an additional independent original cap-one coordinate Z, then ||p_Q||inf <= C_2(h)|d|^-1/2 Z_2^-1/8 and P(Q in J) obeys the same constant times |J|.
new_result.partner_application: The valid account04/B03 collision lemma applied to the new k=2 Plancherel estimate gives P(|R-R'|<=eps) <= [8/(2-q)](e/q)^(1/2) Z_2^-1/4 eps; at h<=1/2 the constant is 8sqrt(e).
new_result.claude_application: For an exact-rank-two residual with eigenvalues abs>=1 and max row leverage <=1/50, a Chernoff half-partition has Z_2>=1/256 and h<=4/50, giving sup_s E|R-s|^-1/2 <=16e^(1/4)=20.5444066670..., uniformly in arbitrary affine terms.

unresolved_implication: In the strict no-pivot N3 class, route every survivor either to a quantitative two-volume bank with h<=1-delta, an already-paid k=3/k=5 diffuse branch, or a hub theorem that tolerates small nonzero hub blocks and genuine two-sided quadratic leakage. The k=2 weighted time integral itself is now paid away from h=1.
